title: Build Wide, Ship Narrow
summary: This article discusses a product development strategy that encourages teams to explore broadly during research and ideation phases while maintaining focus during execution and delivery. The approach balances innovation with disciplined product shipping.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of balancing comprehensive exploration with focused product delivery to avoid feature bloat and scope creep.
why_valuable: Provides a practical framework for teams to innovate widely without sacrificing product focus or delivery velocity.
